extracted.subtask_description: A World War II–era wire service news dispatch (Associated Press/Reuters style) reporting battle, political and homefront developments; includes datelines and distribution metadata. The page is raw newspaper copy intended for publication in local papers.

rubrics_metrics.name: embargo / advance-use restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: "(ADVANCE FOR USE AT 6:30 P.M, EASTERN WAR TIME TONIGHT, FRIDAY, THIS DISPATCH MUST NOT BE TRANSMITTED OUTSIDE THE CONTINENTAL UNITED STATES NOR BROADCAST BEFORE THAT TIME,)"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A clear procedural distribution restriction: the dispatch is embargoed until the stated time and limited geographically (continental U.S.). This instructs editors and broadcasters when and where the copy may be transmitted or aired.
